q1.explanationZh: 第一段末尾说它的速度几乎是英国最快火车的两倍，所以填 twice。

evidence.quote: That is almost twice as fast as the quickest trains in the U.K.

q2.explanationZh: 第二段说这辆车是一位名叫 Stephen Wallis 的工程师造的。

evidence.quote: This amazing car was built by an engineer named Stephen Wallis.

q3.explanationZh: Stephen 说他八岁时得到了第一辆遥控车。

evidence.quote: when I was eight years old and got my first radio-controlled car

q4.explanationZh: 第三段说他用 3D 打印做了许多零件。

evidence.quote: used 3D printing to make many of its parts

q5.explanationZh: 车没有一个大引擎，而是用四个强劲的无人机马达来达到高速。

evidence.quote: it uses four powerful drone motors to reach high speeds

q6.explanationZh: 最大的难题是让车贴着地面，所以他仔细设计车身来让车“留在地面上”。

evidence.quote: Stephen had to design its body carefully to keep the car on the ground.

q7.explanationZh: 最后一段说 The Beast 以每小时 16 英里的优势打破了旧纪录（old record）。

evidence.quote: it beat the old record by 16 miles per hour

q8.explanationZh: 最后一句说他除了拿到吉尼斯纪录，还得到一顶特别的帽子作奖励。

evidence.quote: he also got a special hat as a reward
